delta: # Story 02 — REPORTS-2-WEB admin sees share

of tickets that met their promise (Story: CRM-127)

## Prerequisites

- **REPORTS-2-API (CRM-126)** must be shipped — this story consumes the comput
ed share, counts and "no data" flag returned by the read endpoint. Do not begin without confirming the response shape with

the API author.
- **SERVICE-LEVELS-3-API** must be shipped upstream so the breach rows the share rests on exist.
See rule **S-5** — *a breach is a stored row, never recomputed on read*. The client must not recompute met-

or-missed.
- Familiarity with the existing report page pattern in `web/src/pages/reports/QueueByStatusPage.tsx` (sibling report route, same sh

ell, same loader/error states).
- Familiarity with the admin-only route pattern used for `/audit` in `web/src/app/routes.tsx` around line 161.

---

## Story Goal

An
admin loads a page and sees, for each of the two SLA promises the product makes — **first response** and **resolution** — the
share of tickets that met that promise in the current period, presented as **"82 % (41 of 50)"** with both promises clearly labelled as what
they are. When the period has nothing settled, the screen says so in words and shows no percentage at all. All numbers are locale-formatted; every

sentence with a number in it is built from a slot template (rule **L-51**), never by concatenation.

Explicitly **out

of scope** for this story:

- Anything server-side — the share arrives already computed (**REPORTS-2-API / CRM-126**).
- Any

client-side met-or-missed computation.
- Any chart. This story renders a number, its counts and

a label.
- A period picker — that is **REPORTS-4-WEB (CRM-131)**.

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `scripts/criteria/re
ports.md` — section **REPORTS-2-WEB** at line 120. This is the authoritative acceptance list for this story. Re-read all four cri

teria before starting.
2. `web/src/pages/reports/QueueByStatusPage.tsx` and its hook `web/src/pages/reports/useQueueByStatus.ts` — the sh
ape and idioms of a report page (loader/error/empty, `useRequest`, i18n,

`useFormatters`). Match this pattern; do not invent a new one.
3. `web/src/pages/reports/QueueByStatusPage.test.tsx` — the shape of a report page test. Mir

ror the assertion style (labels, formatted numbers, empty state) rather than inventing your own.
4. `web/src/app/routes.tsx` — read the block

around line 161 that mounts `/audit` admin-only. Mount the new page the same way.
5. `web/src/shared/i18n/format.ts` — read from about line 12 (the `ar-E
G` locale note). Confirm percent and integer formatters live here, and use them via `useFormatters()`; do not call `Intl.NumberFormat` inline.

6. `web/src/shared/i18n/useFormatters.ts` — the hook you will call for percent and integer formatting.
7. `web/src/pages/tickets/history-sentence.ts` and `web/src/pages/tickets/pager-
sentence.ts` — the L-51 slot pattern with U+2068 / U+2069 isolates around a slot. Every sentence you build with

a number in it must be built this way.
8. `web/src/pages/tickets/history-sentence.test.ts` — how sentence builders are unit tested; you will add

one test file the same way.
9. `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — where new user-visible strings and slot templates go. Adding to `

en.ts` without adding to `ar.ts` is a `parity.test.ts` failure.
10. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` and `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — the

guards that will see this page.
11. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` and `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — how a page calls the API

. Reuse; do not add a second client.
12. `web/src/app/auth-context.tsx` and `web/src/app/require-auth.tsx` — how admin gating is enforced
. Reference how `/audit` is gated. Rule L-63: **do not fetch before the subject is known** — the request must not fire until `me` is lo

aded and admin-confirmed.
13. `api/src/features/reports/reports.routes.js` and `api/src/features/reports/reports.read.js` — read the promise-share endpoint that CRM-126 exposes. Cop
y its exact path, query params, and response shape into the hook. If the endpoint is not yet merged, coordinate with C

RM-126's author and mark that block in `## Edge Cases & Failure Modes` before merging.
14. Sibling plan: the prior `re

ports` plan for **QueueByStatusPage** (in `.squad/plans/reports/`) — mirror its section structure and test-file layout.

---

## Product r

ules (from story)

- **Current:** admins have no view of the share of promises met; the only report page today is Queue-by-Status.
- **
New:** admins see two labelled figures — **first response met** and **resolution met** — each expressed as `"P % (M of N)"`

, with a words-only empty state when `N === 0`, and every number locale-formatted through `useFormatters()`.
- **Ow
ned rule S-5** — a breach is a stored row, never recomputed on read. The client must therefore render whatever the API returns; it must not der

ive met/missed from raw ticket data.

---

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — New page: Promise-share report

**

Create file:** `web/src/pages/reports/PromiseSharePage.tsx`

Mirror the top-to-bottom structure of `QueueByStatusPage.tsx`:

- Page-level `

Heading` with the i18n label `reports.promiseShare.title` (e.g. `"Share of promises met"` / Arabic equivalent).
- Two sections, one

per promise kind:
  - **First response** — label from `reports.promiseShare.firstResponse.label`.
  - **Resolution** — label from `reports.promiseShare.resolution.label`.
  - Never use the word **"SLA"** in either

label — the story is explicit.
- For each section, render **one** of:
  - **Result state** (when `total > 0`): the sentence `
reports.promiseShare.result` filled with two slots — `{share}` and `{counts}`, where `counts` is itself the fil
led sentence `reports.promiseShare.counts` (`"{met} of {total}"`). Both slots are wrapped in **U+2068 / U+2069 isolates** by the sentence builder (see task

3).
  - **Empty state** (when `total === 0`): render the string `reports.promiseShare.noData` — e.g. `"Nothing settled in this period."` — with **no percentage element in

the DOM at all**. Use the shared `EmptyState` component.
- Loading uses `Skeleton`; error uses `ErrorState`; both mirror `QueueByStatusPage.tsx`.
- Data source: `

usePromiseShare()` (task 2).
- **Do not** fetch before the subject is known — gate on `me` being resolved and `role ===

'admin'` the way `AuditLogPage.tsx` does (rule **L-63**).

### 2 — Data hook

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/reports/usePromiseShare.ts`

-
Wrap `useRequest` (see `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts`) against the endpoint CRM-126 exposes under `api/src/features/reports/reports.routes.js`. Do not hard-code the URL —
import a shared base helper if one exists in `reports/` already; ot

herwise inline a `const path = '/reports/promise-share'` at the top of the file with a `// CRM-126` comment.
- Return `{ data, loading, error
ns a different shape, adapt the type but keep the "share is null when nothing settled" contract at the hook boundary so the page has

one thing to check.
- The hook must **not fire** while `me` is loading (L-63).

### 3 — Slot-built sentences (L

-51)

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/reports/promise-share-sentence.ts`

Follow `web/src/pages/tickets/history-sentence.ts` and `pager-sentence.ts` exactly:

-
Export `formatShareSentence({ share, counts, t })` that resolves the `reports.promiseShare.result` template and substitutes `{share}` and `{counts}` **wrapped in U+2

068 (FSI) … U+2069 (PDI)**. Do not concatenate.
- Export `formatCountsSentence({ met, total, t })` that resolves `reports.promiseShare.counts` with `{met}` and `{

total}`, each isolate-wrapped.
- Both take pre-formatted strings from `useFormatters()` — the builder does **not** call `Intl.NumberFormat` itself.

Digit formatting lives in `web/src/shared/i18n/format.ts`.

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/reports/promise-share-sentence.test.ts` — mirror `history-sentence.test.ts`. Assert:
- English

: `"82 % (41 of 50)"` with isolates present.
- Arabic: the same template with locale digits and correct isolate placement.
- That concatenation is

not used (test the raw returned string includes `\u2068` around each slot).

### 4 — i18n strings

**File:** `web/src/shared/i18n/en.

are: {
    title: 'Share of promises met',
    firstResponse: { label: 'First response' },
    resolution:    { label: 'Resolution' },
    result:  '{share} ({counts})',
    counts:  '{met} of {total}',
    noData:

'Nothing settled in this period.',
    error:   'The share could not be loaded.',
  },
}
```

**File:** `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

Add the **same key set** with
Arabic strings. Missing any key here fails `parity.test.ts`. Do **not** translate the placeholder tokens (`{share}`, `{counts}`,

`{met}`, `{total}`); leave them literal so the sentence builder can substitute them.

### 5 — Route mount (admin only)

**File:** `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

Around line 161 you
will find the `/audit` route wired admin-only. Add `/reports/promise-share` immediately after it (or in the existing `reports` block
if one exists) using the identical admin-gating mechanism. Lazy-load if the sibling `QueueByStatusPage` route lazy-loads;

otherwise import statically to match the existing style.

### 6 — Navigation entry (only if the sibling report has one)
Check `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx` for how `QueueByStatusPage` is linked from the shell. If a "
Reports" section already lists Queue-by-Status, add a **Promise share** entry beside it, admin-only
, key `reports.promiseShare.title`. If Queue-by-Status is not in the shell, do not add navigation here — leave it to

the reports index story.

### 7 — Page test

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/reports/PromiseSharePage.test.tsx`

Mirror `QueueByStatusPage.test.tsx`. Cover

:

1. Admin loads the page; loader appears, then both labelled sections render with the API's canned data. Assert the label strings appear (not the

word "SLA"), and assert the formatted sentence text `"82 % (41 of 50)"` and its Arabic counterpart.
2. Empty state: API returns `total: 0` for one kind —

the words render, and there is **no `%` character** in that section's DOM.
3. Both-empty: both sections render the

words-only empty state and no percentage anywhere.
4. Non-admin (or unauthenticated) redirects the same way `/audit` does today — assert against

the same test helper used in `AuditLogPage.test.tsx`.
5. Fetch is **not** dispatched before `me` resolves (L-63). Use the `stub-me` helper (`web/src/testing/stub-me.ts`) to

gate the request; assert the API mock is untouched during the pending state.

---

## Backend Tasks

**No
backend changes required.** All computation, including "no data", is owned by **REPORTS-2-API (CRM-126)**. If the endpoint's response shape does not match the type in
task 2, raise the mismatch with that story's author — do **not** paper it over in the web hook by recomputing `share` from `met / total`,

because doing so would violate rule **S-5**.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **`total === 0` for one kind, positive for the other** — the emp

ty-kind section renders words only; the other renders the sentence. Verified in `PromiseSharePage.test.tsx` case 2.
- **`total === 0` for both kinds** — both sections render

words only; no `%` anywhere in the DOM. Case 3.
- **API returns `share` present but `total === 0`** — treat `total === 0` as authoritative and

render the empty state; ignore any stray `share`. Enforced in `usePromiseShare.ts` mapping.
- **API 4xx/5xx** — render `ErrorState` with

`reports.promiseShare.error`, matching `QueueByStatusPage`'s handling.
- **Arabic locale (`ar-EG`)** — digits must render in the
locale's numerals via `useFormatters()`; the sentence must remain right-to-left correct because of the U+2068/U+2

069 isolates in the slot builder. Covered by `promise-share-sentence.test.ts`.
- **Non-admin arriving at the URL directly** — redirect /

403 the same way `/audit` does. Case 4.
- **`me` still loading on mount** — hook must not fetch (L-63). Case 5.
- **End
point not yet merged (CRM-126 open)** — do not merge this story; the page cannot be verified against a real response. Flag in P

R description.
- **Rounding of `share`** — the API decides the rounding; the page trusts it. Do not round on the client.

---

##

Test Plan

1. **Unit** — `web/src/pages/reports/promise-share-sentence.test.ts` (new). Asserts slot substitution, U+2068/U+2069 isolate w

rapping, and that no code path concatenates.
2. **Component** — `web/src/pages/reports/PromiseSharePage.test.tsx` (new). Five cases listed in task 7

.
3. **i18n parity** — `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` (existing) runs untouched; must pass after edits to `en.ts` and `ar.ts`.

4. **No hard-coded strings** — `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` (existing) runs untouched; must see the new page and stay green.
5. **Reg

ression** — `QueueByStatusPage.test.tsx` still passes; route table test (`web/src/app/routing.test.tsx` if present) still passes.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **
Frontend runs:** `cd web && npm test` — all new and existing suites green (parity, no-hardcoded-strings, sentence builder

, page test).
2. **Frontend builds:** `cd web && npm run build` — `tsc -b && vite build` must succeed. The web suite does **not** typecheck under `npm test`; the

build is the only gate that does. A change vitest alone has seen is not verified.
3. **Backend builds:** `cd api && npm test` — no changes

expected here, but run once to confirm nothing broke (route contract tests, `openapi-contract.test.js`).
4. **Regression:** manually visit `/re

ports/promise-share` as an admin against a seeded API (`cd api && npm run seed-demo` then `cd api && npm start`, `cd web && npm run dev`). Confirm:
   - Both labelled sections render.

- Numbers format for both `en` and `ar-EG` (switch via the language toggle).
   - Empty-state wording appears when the API returns `total: 0

`.
   - Direct visit as a non-admin redirects the same way `/audit` does.
5. **No AI attribution anywhere:** `git grep -Ei 'cop
ilot|chatgpt|claude|openai|anthropic|generated by ai|ai-assisted'` — must return nothing in the diff, in

commit messages, or in ignore files.

---

## Done Criteria

- [ ] `PromiseSharePage.tsx`, `usePromiseSh

are.ts`, `promise-share-sentence.ts` exist under `web/src/pages/reports/`.
- [ ] Each promise is labelled **First response** / **Resolution** (or the Arabic equivalents); the word "SLA"

appears nowhere on the page.
- [ ] Every rendered share is accompanied by its counts, formatted as `"P % (M of N)"`, in both English and Arabic locales, via `useFormatters

()`.
- [ ] When `total === 0`, the page renders words and no percentage element exists in the DOM.
- [ ] All numbered slots are inserted through

the sentence builder with **U+2068 / U+2069** isolates; no concatenation is used to place a number into a sentence (**L-51**).
- [ ] The page is mounted admin-only

, mirroring `/audit`; a non-admin visiting the URL is refused the same way.
- [ ] The API request does not fire while `me` is loading (**L-63**).
- [ ] The page

does not compute met-or-missed; the share arrives from the API (**S-5**).
- [ ] `parity.test.ts` and `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts

` are green.
- [ ] `cd web && npm test` and `cd web && npm run build` both pass.
- [ ] `cd api && npm test` still passes with no changes.
- [ ] No comm

it, doc, or ignore-file entry mentions AI assistance.

**STOP HERE. Report to the user and wait for confirmation before proceeding to the next story.
